Alex: EOD handoff — quick async check. I'm on-call til 02:00 UTC. Current state: embed queue still hovering high but healthy, one degraded regen in eu-west1 that's being throttled. I'll list what I did / blockers / next steps below.

Maria: What I did: rotated kvcache nodes (5->5), cleared stale prefetched entries, ran small replay to warm caches. Observed ~7% drop in p99 for embed reads.

Sam: Blocker: regen worker 3 in eu-west1 still OOMing intermittently. Restarted it twice. Logs show repeated spikes after big batch jobs. I'm queuing a rollback to previous image in 15m if no fix.

Lee: Today: monitoring autoscaler configs and canary. Quick note — autoscaler spike policy still uses cpu metric; switching to queue_depth in progress (PR open: https://github.com/redwood/pr/4488).

Alex: Mitigations in flight: 1) paused large-batch ingestion in eu-west1 (ticket #INC-9872), 2) scaled regen workers + affinity to different nodes, 3) enabled temporary rate limit on /regen endpoint for non-critical customers.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-9872 | status: mitigated | summary: large ingestion paused, autoscale triggered. See https://incidents.redwood.ai/9872

Maria: Next steps: follow up tomorrow morning to check eviction rates, will add a perf test for the new kvcache rotation script. Also leaving a short runbook note in ops-runbooks/kvcache-rotation.md

Sam: If regen worker keeps OOMing after rollback, plan B is to drain and repro on dev-stack with the failing batch payload. Ping me if you see repeated OOMs.

Lee: FYI I've added lightweight alert: 'regen-oom-count > 3 in 10m' and set pager to oncall-team. If it fires and Sam's offline, escalate to Alex.

Alex: Thanks — I'll stay available. If anything urgent ping @alex or call my cell. :phone: End of thread.
